gem_guidance.text: Phase 4 adds Carved Witch Doctor's Stick for Badges of Justice. This wand is both better than anything else available in the slot, giving 30 Spell Power if socketed with Runed Crimson Spinel , while also being significantly easier to obtain.

title: Burning Crusade Classic Shadow Priest DPS Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 4 Gear Guide - Wowhead
